# What reading each WAV, AIFF and APE fixture in this folder gives, written
# from the RIFF/WAVE, AIFF/AIFF-C, APEv2 and Monkey's Audio layouts
# (tool/make_lossless_tag_fixtures.py builds the files and says what each one
# tests). Replayed by native/linthra_core/src/tags/shared_cases_test.rs.
#
# Same columns as cases.txt. WAV: an id3 chunk's frames, else LIST/INFO;
# length is the data that is there over the byte rate. AIFF: COMM's frames
# over its rate. MP3 tags: ID3v2, then APE, then ID3v1. Monkey's Audio: its
# header's frames and blocks over its rate.

wav_odd_chunk.wav	After junk	-	-	-	-	500000	-
wav_cut_short.wav	Cut	-	-	-	-	500000	-
aiff_basic.aiff	Aiff	Apple	-	-	-	2000000	-
aifc_id3.aifc	Aifc ID3	-	-	Album	-	3000000	0102030405
aiff_22050.aiff	Half rate	-	-	-	-	1500000	-
